text:
We also just had a baby and faced the same issue. To get an appointment for Tipat Chalav you don’t need a TZ number or for the baby to be registered, once we had registered at the misrad hapnim we got an appointment with the paediatrician pretty quickly, but we went through Maccabi. 

Also I’m pretty sure once you register at the misrad hapnim it’s instant so you can sign up for clalit the same day (my husband did it, so I’m not 100% sure)
